window_definition: Four actual 64-decision windows ending at the first major white flash before each visible life loss in the verified run-121 replay; screen stacks use the four recorded raw video frames immediately preceding each decision.
method: Load each frozen 21-action screen network, compute softmax probability of the learned CONTINUE_PREVIOUS choice on identical verified four-frame inputs, and sum those probabilities separately over each window. No sampled actions, rewards, parameters, or training data are changed.
interpretation: PPO strongly lowered continuation propensity near the repeated loss on identical visible inputs. The actual selected replay also used continuation only 4/3/1/5 times in its own pre-flash windows. This supports learned suppression rather than merely a different sampled trajectory, but does not prove which gradient terms caused it or that continuation could solve the obstacle.
